next.reason: 1985: 'REPLACING {ALPHABETIC|ALPHANUMERIC|NUMERIC|ALPHANUMERIC-EDITED|NUMERIC-EDITED} DATA BY'; 2023: '[ WITH FILLER ] [ {ALL|category-name} TO VALUE ] [ THEN REPLACING … ] [ THEN TO DEFAULT ]; category-name adds BOOLEAN, NATIONAL, DATA-POINTER…'. 2023 format still accepts every 1985 form but adds the WITH FILLER, TO VALUE and TO DEFAULT phrases and eight more REPLACING categories, so more programs are accepted.
